note: Example-image registry for the Sumbu B gallery. Separate from the knowledge base (kb-schema.json unchanged). Up to 3 radiographs per entity, freely licensed (CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA). Only records with status 'approved' (owner-reviewed) are shown. Fields: file (path under web/), caption_id (our own words), site, source_title, source_url, author, repository, licence, licence_url, changes, status (candidate | approved | rejected). Selection rule (owner, 2026-11-17): only the most typical radiograph of each entity; images from sources that call the case atypical, unusual, rare-site, aggressive, giant, multifocal, a mimic or misdiagnosed are excluded.
